delta.vi: Thiết kế hai capture slots cho hai prescribed runs: mỗi slot liệt kê reset, visible input, expected output và case id; cả hai vẫn PENDING Stage 5/6.
delta.en: Design two capture slots for two prescribed runs: each lists reset, visible input, expected output and case id; both remain PENDING Stage 5/6.

after.vi: Trạng thái đích theo invariant; Stage 7 sẽ triển khai replay.
after.en: Target state under the invariant; Stage 7 will implement replay.

invariant_or_criterion.vi: Every planned capture is attributable to exactly one test case and shows all source-required observable evidence, while no Stage 4 field states that execution, output or screenshot already exists.
invariant_or_criterion.en: Every planned capture is attributable to exactly one test case and shows all source-required observable evidence, while no Stage 4 field states that execution, output or screenshot already exists.

prediction.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.
prediction.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

feedback.vi: Đối chiếu event, bất biến và output; nếu sai dùng Reset rồi replay.
feedback.en: Compare event, invariant and output; if wrong, use Reset and replay.
